third_party_evaluations.summary: Python for security automation, parsing, network/forensic tooling.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced specialty: 3. The existing unordered-specialty rule applies when at least one reviewer identifies a specialty track. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Python automation, parsing and forensic-tool development constitute a focused supporting specialization; accreditation does not turn the narrow use case and zero-experience profile into general security seniority.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Python automation, parsing and forensic tooling form a focused enabling specialty for security practitioners. Recorded accreditation and COOL recognition help, but zero listed experience and no specified coding practical leave seniority unresolved.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded Python automation, parsing and forensic-tooling scope is a focused supporting branch of security practice. Its specialty hint and narrow use case are more informative than a general progression tier, especially with no experience prerequisite.
